name: wsSubscribe
description: Accepted as a no-op for forward compatibility. In RustCFML, clients join rooms only through server-side socket.join(); there is no server-side subscribe to call. Feature-detecting code that calls wsSubscribe() will not error.

rustcfml.notes: No-op; room joins are server-side via socket.join().

links.title: RustCFML WebSocket documentation
links.description: Full documentation of the RustCFML realtime engine and rooms.

examples.title: Feature-detecting code
examples.description: Calls to wsSubscribe() are accepted and do nothing; clients join rooms from server code instead.
